lines.speaker: maria-311
lines.text: Maria-311. Ready.

lines.speaker: maria-320
lines.text: Maria-320. Ready.

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: Maria-330. Ready.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: Good. Tell me about your positions.

lines.speaker: maria-311
lines.text: I'll take point and act as lookout, as well as handle scouting.

lines.speaker: maria-320
lines.text: I'll take center and cover both flanks while providing supporting fire.

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: That leaves me at the rear, where I'll keep watch and provide sniper fire.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: That's amazing. We didn't even have to have a planning session.

lines.speaker: maria-311
lines.text: I know myself best, after all.

lines.speaker: maria-320
lines.text: Hehe. It's a strange feeling, forming a squad with myself and heading out.

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: Yeah, and yet it's not awkward at all compared to what I expected.

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: Honestly, I was a little worried that we might butt heads.

lines.speaker: maria-311
lines.text: We really all think the same.

lines.speaker: maria-320
lines.text: Yeah, we were probably able to get on the same page so quickly because we all have the same thoughts and worries.

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: Hehe. That must be it.

lines.speaker: maria-311
lines.text: Well then, why don't we get going?

lines.speaker: maria-320
lines.text: Wow, I was thinking the exact same thing!

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: Me too, me too.
The three of them get into positions and walk forward.
Watching them on the monitor, Doctor Maria feels hope.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: ... Good. This might actually work.
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*
The Marias all fire with their machine guns.
Their opponent is a Lord-class Rapture.
The Rapture concentrates on Maria-311. She ducks behind cover, while Maria-320 and Maria-330 attack the Rapture.
The Rapture switches targets to Maria-320, at which point Maria-311 and Maria-330 strike.
This pattern repeats several times,
and the Lord-class Rapture eventually goes down in an explosion.

lines.speaker: maria-311
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: maria-320
lines.text: Whoa.

lines.speaker: maria-330
lines.text: We... did it, huh?

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: ... Amazing.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: Three Nikkes just defeated a Lord-class Rapture... It's incredible.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: I never dreamed it would work this well. Let's, uh... let's keep going.
The Marias press on.
They engage in battle after battle, with all three remaining completely unscathed.
They keep pressing on.
They make it 10.5% of the way to their target destination. It's the furthest and fastest they've ever gone.
Doctor Maria is unable to hide her excitement at the unprecedented progress.
As soon as it hits 14.3%, Doctor Maria lets out a cheer.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: It worked! I knew this method was right!
That cheering stops the moment two Lord-class Raptures appear at once.
One of them kicks Maria-320 with its foreleg and sends her lower body flying.
As she crawls along the ground trying to escape, the Rapture fires a beam from its head as if to mock her.
Maria-320's head burns as a horrific scream rings out across the battlefield.
The Rapture slams into Maria-330 and sends her tumbling across the ground.
The other Rapture, who had been lying in wait, stomps her with its four legs.
*Thump, thump, thump*
The sound of the ground being pummeled is accompanied by the sound of something breaking, the sound of something being crushed,
and screams.
When all the sounds stop, Maria-311 sinks to the ground.
The two Raptures approach, but Maria-311 doesn't look at them.
She looks at the now unrecognizable remains of Maria-320 and Maria-330.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: ... Argh.

lines.speaker: doctormaria_op_l
lines.text: 311. Go ahead and die. We'll try again.
*Fwoosh*
A high-speed beam pierces through Maria-311's abdomen.
Maria-311 feels her mind go hazy.
Everything blurs,
but the one thing she feels with perfect clarity is...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: 331. You're here.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Aw, that was really unfortunate.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll make five this time. Let's go again.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You should be able to get further.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: 331? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: Um... D-Doctor.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I'm sorry to ask, but... could I rest a little before heading out?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Huh? I don't mind, but why?

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: Oh, it's just...

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: ... I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: A...fraid? Of what? The Raptures?

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: Of... dying.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... What do you mean? Why would you suddenly be...
Doctor Maria quickly walks over and checks the screen.
The sound of frantic typing fills the room as she checks the NIMPH data.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Why did this come back...?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I know for sure that I erased the fear of death...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: 331, what happened?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Tell me!

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I-I saw what it looks like to die.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I-I saw myself dying.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I saw myself scream, and thrash, and become unrecognizable...

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: And die...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It's not like it's your first time, or even your hundredth!

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I-I never saw myself when I died.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: But this time I did. I saw "me" die.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I saw how it happens, and what's left afterward.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I'll die that way too, won't I?

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: Painfully, with my eyes full of terror,

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: eventually becoming unrecognizable...

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: That's how I'll die...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll go ahead and erase that fear of death.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: But it's faster to make a new you than to edit your NIMPH right now,

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: so you need to die, 331. That's the most efficient way to do this.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: ... Okay.
Maria-331 draws a pistol.
She points it at her head and puts her finger on the trigger,
but she can't pull it.
*Clack, clack*
Maria-331's body trembles.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: What're you doing? Hurry up.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I... I can't pull the trigger.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: I'm... I'm scared.
Irritated, Doctor Maria snatches the pistol from Maria-331.
She aims it at her head.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: ... Doctor.

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: Why did it take until now for me to understand?

lines.speaker: maria-331
lines.text: Death is so—
*Bang!*
*Thump*
Silence settles over the lab.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Oh... Ohhh...
Her arm won't stop trembling.
Her finger on the trigger has gone rigid and won't straighten.
She pries it loose and tears it away with her other hand.
*Drip, drip*
Sweat pours off her like rain.
Her breathing won't settle. Her vision is blurred.
After a short while, she manages to catch her breath, and her vision returns to normal.
As soon as it does, the first thing to enter her vision...
... is the corpse of a Nikke with eyes wide open and blood pouring from her head.
A Nikke that looks exactly like her.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Erk... Hnghhh...!
... Maria-332, 333, 334, 335, and 336 deployed simultaneously.
Annihilated at the 5.6% mark.
... Maria-337 to 346 deployed simultaneously.
Annihilated at the 5.5% mark.
... Maria-347 to 351 deployed simultaneously. Maria-352 to 357 deployed as reinforcements.
Annihilated at the 4.3% mark due to friendly fire.
... After each death, the fear of death is generated within the NIMPH with 100% probability.
No matter how many times I erase it, it always comes back.
From Maria-505 onward, deployment changed to solo operations.
Progress to the target destination... never exceeds 5%.
The fear of death makes every action hesitant and excessively cautious.
From Maria-714 onward, it began to appear as a default spec during the production process.
I can no longer erase it, no matter what I try.
... I thought I knew everything about NIMPH, but I was wrong.
The project reached Maria-999 without any meaningful results.
Thereafter, I deemed numbering each Maria model to be meaningless.
They will be designated collectively as Maria-n until any significant results are achieved.
I've stopped counting the number of Maria-ns I've deployed.
The furthest they've gotten is 15%.
However, that was simply due to luck. Everything since has hovered around 7%.
And only one week remains until Enikk's deadline.
The project is a failure.
Barring a miracle, of course.
I'm going to be remembered as a failure who played games with people's lives,
and my mother's legacy will continue to be tarnished.
I've failed.
